_comment: Simplified sample labels in openFDA's response shape, for tests only. Texts are paraphrased, not real label wording.

boxed_warning: WARNING: BLEEDING RISK. Warfarin can cause major or fatal bleeding.
drug_interactions: Drugs that increase bleeding risk include antiplatelet agents and NSAIDs. Monitor INR closely when starting or stopping other medicines.

warnings: Stomach bleeding warning: the chance is higher if you take a blood thinning (anticoagulant) or steroid drug.
drug_interactions: Anticoagulants: ibuprofen and anticoagulants such as warfarin have a synergistic effect on bleeding.

contraindications: Use with MAOIs, or within 14 days of stopping MAOIs, is contraindicated because of the risk of serotonin syndrome.
drug_interactions: Serotonergic drugs increase the risk of serotonin syndrome.
Do not combine with other antidepressants.

warnings: Liver warning: severe liver damage may occur if you take more than the maximum daily amount.
